name: ar-security-triage-external
description: Reformat, evaluate against the Arweave threat model, and post an assessment on an externally reported security issue: an existing security-tracker issue, or one or more pasted reports, each filed as a new tracker issue first, after checking for duplicate and related tracker issues. Drafts a reply to the reporter when the report does not hold up. Use only when the user explicitly invokes this skill with an issue URL or the report text.
